description: Lists the site's Xodia Forms (forms that post to Xodia, whose messages the owner reads in the Content tab): each form's id, name, status (active or paused), the file and line it is in, recipients, the Turnstile spam check, notifications (each message or a daily digest), webhooks, unread and kept messages, the field names it accepts, and code issues that stop messages arriving (its own submit code, field names that aren't fixed, refused fields like passwords), with the fix. Also this month's messages against the plan's monthly cap. Read it before changing a form. Reads only.
name: list_forms
title: List forms
